text: dsh-user-rules 为 DSH 网页端提供用户规则设置页。用户可在列表中新增、修改和删除规则，内容保存在当前 profile 配置。Host 会把规则整理为编号列表，注入名为 user-rules 的 systemPrompt 区段，供后续提示词装配读取。适合希望持续使用个人开发规范的 DSH 用户。

dsh-user-rules adds a rules editor to DSH web settings. Users add, edit, or remove rules saved in the active profile. The host formats them as a numbered user-rules section in the system prompt. It suits users who want personal guidelines included in later prompts.
dsh-user-rules 的功能「规则编辑」：在网页设置中添加、修改或删除规则，并保存到当前 profile 的 user-rules 配置。
dsh-user-rules 的功能「提示词注入」：Host 将非空规则编成编号列表，注册为 user-rules systemPrompt 区段。
dsh-user-rules 的功能「读取最新规则」：提示词装配时读取 volatile 规则值，使后续提示词反映已保存内容。
想给 DSH 会话加上自己常用的开发规范。

我希望系统提示词每次都带上自定义规则。
让 DSH 自动把我写的规则放进提示词。
想在网页上随时增删个人规则。
I want my coding guidelines included in each DSH prompt.
Can I manage custom rules from the web settings page?
我想把常用指令整理成可维护的规则清单。

@railgun52/dsh-user-rules README · dsh-user-rules — User rules settings page：Rules you add here are concatenated into a `user-rules` systemPrompt section, so the model obeys them on the next turn — edit and it takes effect without a restart. The page is a list editor over the `user-rules` profile-config namespace; the Host half owns the schema and the systemPrompt section, the browser half owns the editor card.

@railgun52/dsh-user-rules README · Features：| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Settings page | A first-level Settings section `用户规则` with add/edit/remove/reorder card list |
| systemPrompt injection | The resolved `rules` become a numbered systemPrompt section named `user-rules` (order `-50`) |
| Live edits | `rules` is declared `.volatile()`; the section text reads the live value at assembly time, so new turns pick up edits with no remount |
| Profile-config backed | Values persist to the active profile's plugin config; the page reads/writes through the shared `configForms` namespace |
